glosses: to consider more thoroughly, to delve deeper into

examples.text: Avec ces propos et d’autres semblables, le pauvre gentilhomme perdait le jugement. Il passait les nuits et se donnait la torture pour les comprendre, pour les approfondir, pour leur tirer le sens des entrailles, ce qu’Aristote lui-même n’aurait pu faire, s’il fût ressuscité tout exprès pour cela.
examples.translation: With these passages and other similar ones, the poor gentleman lost his judgement. He spent his nights and tortured himself to understand them, to consider them more deeply, to take from them their deepest meaning, which Aristotle himself would not have been able to do, had he been resurrected for that very purpose.
examples.english: With these passages and other similar ones, the poor gentleman lost his judgement. He spent his nights and tortured himself to understand them, to consider them more deeply, to take from them their deepest meaning, which Aristotle himself would not have been able to do, had he been resurrected for that very purpose.

glosses: Rendre plus profond, creuser plus avant.

examples.text: Approfondir un puits qui n’a pas assez d’eau.
Il ne faut pas les approfondir davantage.
Il a approfondi cette science.
Approfondir une question, une matière, un sujet d’ouvrage.
Un examen approfondi.
La crevasse s’approfondit chaque hiver.
Il est nécessaire de s’approfondir soi-même pour bien se connaître.

translations.source_sense_description: Rendre plus profond, creuser plus avant

glosses: bei etwas, das nach unten, in die Tiefe geht, noch mehr Substanz entfernen, wodurch es noch tiefer als zuvor wird

examples.text: Die Gräben links und rechts des Weges werden dieses Jahr vertieft.

glosses: mit mehr Details anreichern, intensiver und umfangreicher machen/werden

examples.text: Ich habe mir vorgenommen, meine Kenntnisse über neuronale Vorgänge zu vertiefen.
Die gegenseitige Zuneigung vertiefte sich im Laufe der Zeit.
Das ruhige Atmen vertieft die innere Ruhe.

glosses: ein Teil eines Kleidungsstückes (tiefer, nach unten) versetzen

examples.text: „Den Halsausschnitt an der Schulter um 2,5 cm erweitern, an VM und HM um 2,5 cm vertiefen.“
Wenn Kilian sich in sein Hobby vertieft, vergisst er reglmäßig, zu Abend zu essen.
Ruhig saß sie da, in die Zeitung vertieft.
„Eine vierventilige enharmonische Trompete in hoch b hätte eine gute Höhe und wäre auch in der Tiefe rein: jeder Überblaston ließe sich durch die Ventile bis zu einer Oktave vertiefen.“

translations.source_sense_description: Rendre plus profond, creuser plus avant

examples.text: They deepened the well by 200 feet.

glosses: To make darker or more intense; to darken

examples.text: The event deepened the prevailing gloom.

glosses: To make more poignant or affecting; to increase in degree

examples.text: News of her death deepened my sorrow.
The tuner deepened the tone of the organ.

glosses: To make more thorough or extensive.

examples.text: The class deepened my understanding of the subject.
The shared experiences deepened our relationship.

glosses: To make more sound or heavy.

examples.text: The hypnotist then proceeded to deepen his trance.
The water deepens as you go toward the middle of the channel.

glosses: To become darker or more intense

examples.text: The crisis deepened in the following weeks.

We may be pardoned our nostalgia, those of us who can remember the old days, the days before the grouping and before standardisation, when we see, as today we see so often, the derelict and abandoned buildings of what were once railway stations, for the life which they used to enjoy we lived with them. There they stand, today, as the dusk deepens about them, lampless, cold and deserted.
His voice deepened with age.

glosses: To become more thorough or extensive.

examples.text: His skill in deciphering the texts deepened with practice.
The conversation deepened and they began to truly share.
He's in the process of breaking up with one boyfriend, who refuses to let their relationship deepen, and courting another, who promises to be somebody with whom he could grow old.

glosses: To become more sound or heavy.

examples.text: The new bed allowed my sleep to deepen.

examples.translation: 读着这些段落以及其他类似的文字，这位可怜的先生失去了判断力。他夜以继日，折磨自己，试图理解这些文字，更深入地思考它们，从中汲取最深层的意义。即便亚里士多德为此而复活，他也无法做到这一点。
